changelog: Editable Menu Items: Public navigation menu items can now be edited inline (Title, Destination URL, Open in new tab) and reordered directly from Admin Panel Settings
Strict 404 Protection on Admin & Private Pages: Visiting any admin page or private page without an active admin login strictly returns a 404 Not Found page instead of redirecting to the login screen
Customizable Admin Login Page Path: Added Admin Login Page Path setting in Admin Panel Settings to change the login URL slug dynamically and hide default /login.php behind a 404 error
Zero Admin/Private Links on Public Pages: Removed all admin/private links and control bars from public episode pages, setup screens, and headers
